title: Write the greeting file
body:
## Goal
Create `src/greeting.txt` containing exactly the single line `hello from perpetua`.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` contains exactly `hello from perpetua` followed by a newline.

## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/greeting.txt').read() != 'hello from perpetua\n')"`

## Context
- The gate already recognizes this exact greeting content, as documented by the prior Policymaker report in `.session/history/sessions/313/8c884b4033171fb8f65765ab4c5b13f396b292b3041fcbdebd0becd2d626712c.md`.
- This is iteration 0; the farewell must be written in a later iteration after this iteration closes and its record exists.

## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt`
- `.session/history/sessions/313/8c884b4033171fb8f65765ab4c5b13f396b292b3041fcbdebd0becd2d626712c.md`
